steps.message:
## Static Dependency Report

**Scope:** StaticHeavy
**Files scanned:** 4 `.cs` files (`Program.cs`, `Services/OrderProcessor.cs`, `Services/ConfigLoader.cs`, `Services/NotificationService.cs`; `obj/` and `bin/` excluded)
**Total static call sites:** 28

### Category Summary

| Category | Call sites | Recommended abstraction |
|----------|-----------|-------------------------|
| Time | 7 | TimeProvider (.NET 8+) |
| File System | 11 | System.IO.Abstractions |
| Console | 4 | IConsole / ILogger |
| Environment | 2 | IEnvironmentProvider |
| Network | 2 | IHttpClientFactory |
| Randomness / identity | 1 | injected Random / IGuidProvider |
| Culture / serialization | 1 | explicit JsonSerializerOptions |

The seven category totals reconcile to the grand total of 28.

### Top patterns

| # | Pattern | Count |
|---|---------|-------|
| 1 | File.WriteAllText | 4 |
| 2 | DateTime.UtcNow | 6 |
| 3 | Console.WriteLine | 4 |
| 4 | Directory.Exists / CreateDirectory | 4 |
| 5 | Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable | 2 |

(`DateTime.Now` appears once, in OrderProcessor.cs.)

### Most affected files

| File | Static calls | Categories |
|------|-------------|------------|
| Services/OrderProcessor.cs | 12 | Time, File System, Environment, Console, Randomness, Serialization |
| Services/ConfigLoader.cs | 6 | File System, Console |
| Services/NotificationService.cs | 9 | Time, File System, Environment, Console, Network |
| Program.cs | 1 | Console |

### Worst offender

`Services/OrderProcessor.cs` carries 12 of the 28 sites — start the audit remediation there.

### Migration priority

1. **Time (7)** — `TimeProvider`, no NuGet cost on .NET 8+.
2. **File System (11)** — `System.IO.Abstractions`.
3. **Console (4)** — route through `ILogger`.

This report is section-organised and ready to hand to your team lead.
